pages.title: Finding Metal in the Wild
pages.text: In this world, you cannot mine ores with a pickaxe. Instead, you must find §6natural metal blocks§r on the surface. These are native metal deposits that can be used directly.$(br2)There are three types of natural metals:$(br)$(li)§cCopper§r - Most common$(br)$(li)§fSilver§r - Quite rare$(br)$(li)§eGold§r - Very rare

pages.title: §cNatural Copper
pages.text: §cNatural Copper Block§r$(br)$(li)Spawn: Mountains, Plains, River banks$(br)$(li)Height: Surface layer (Y=55~180)$(br)$(li)Feature: Rocky ground or near clay pits$(br)$(li)Rarity: Common$(br2)§6Tip:§r Copper is the most basic forging metal - look for it first.

pages.title: §fNatural Silver
pages.text: §fNatural Silver Block§r$(br)$(li)Spawn: High altitude mountains & any surface$(br)$(li)Height: Surface layer (Y=55~180)$(br)$(li)Feature: Andesite, Granite or Stone surface$(br)$(li)Rarity: Quite rare$(br2)§6Tip:§r Silver has excellent forging properties for fine accessories.

pages.title: §eNatural Gold
pages.text: §eNatural Gold Block§r$(br)$(li)Spawn: River banks, Beaches & any surface$(br)$(li)Height: Surface layer (Y=55~180)$(br)$(li)Feature: Sand, Sandstone or Gravel surface$(br)$(li)Rarity: Very rare$(br2)§6Tip:§r Gold is the most precious metal for high-end decorations.

pages.title: §6Copper Grass Flower
pages.text: Nature provides a compass!$(br2)§bCopper Grass Flowers§r are natural indicators of copper ore deposits nearby.$(br)$(li)Look for these distinctive blue-green flowers$(br)$(li)They grow in areas where copper ore is underground$(br2)Follow the flowers to find rich copper deposits!
